{{Top|leg}}
A '''blast wall''' was a security feature employed by [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] to help guard ships from theft<ref name="SO">{{JournalCite|3|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref> and to provide security to the installation. [[Graith starport]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] was surrounded by a blast wall.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref> Blast walls were used at the [[Unidentified spaceport (Zelos II)|spaceport]] on [[Zelos II]], although this is did not deter a [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|Special Ops team]] from stealing the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']].
